dt: Gen-4 solicitation NSF 24-576 archived; NSF said a new solicitation was anticipated in 2026
e: Multi-institution engineering centers that combine research, workforce development and industry partnership around a societal need. Lead-institution limits apply in past cycles; no citizenship restriction.
unv: New solicitation not yet posted as of 2026-11-09 (the updates page still shows the Sep 17, 2025 notice); award size and limits for next cycle unknown.

yale.t: The Yale Office of Research Development holds an NSF ERC Idea Exchange on Tue Dec 8, 2026, 12 to 1 pm (in person, registration required and limited): faculty give 2-minute flash talks and look for cross-campus collaborators ahead of the next ERC solicitation. Questions: researchdev@yale.edu.
